subject.title: feat(channels): add typed cross-surface approval actions

question: Should `approval`, `url`, and `web-app` become the permanent public `MessagePresentationAction` variants in the plugin SDK as part of the durable approvals stack?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and follows repository architecture, but it expands a shipped external plugin contract and coordinates several stacked feature PRs; that permanent API direction requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve all typed variants
options.body: Adopt all three variants as the canonical SDK contract and land after the stack and proof gates pass.

options.title: Land approval only
options.body: Keep the approval variant in this stack and defer URL/web-app normalization to a separate API decision.

options.title: Pause the API expansion
options.body: Retain the existing command/callback contract until a different cross-surface design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve all typed variants
recommendation.body: Adopt all three variants as the canonical SDK contract and land after the stack and proof gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows this person introduced the portable action surface and has the strongest recent approval-area provenance.
